dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped light-toned rings with scalloped, high-contrast outer perimeters. The interior of the rings shows a distinct gradient transition to a lighter grey-blue hue compared to the dark surrounding field. Most prominent in the central dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid light-intensity pixel clusters concentrated primarily in the anterior region and interspersed between the larger macro-annuli along the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Primary centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle in the mid-dorsal region. A secondary linear alignment is visible through the centroids of four smaller 'O' structures along the posterior-dorsal curve.
